ns2:course.label: Life Contingencies II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of MATH 471. Introduction to tabular or parametric survival models with single or multiple-life states; life insurance and annuity premium calculations; reserving and profit measures; introductions to universal life insurances, participating insurances, pension plans and retirement benefits. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Credit is not given for MATH 472 and MATH 565. Prerequisite: MATH 471.
